issues.description: Attribute type mismatch for ExcellenceLand.excellencyLevel: The UML in the problem statement (problem_statement.md) declares ExcellenceLand.excellencyLevel as type double, but the reference solution (solution_repository/src/de/tum/in/ase/ExcellenceLand.java) declares the field and constructor parameter as int. This inconsistency between the UML/specification and the provided solution will confuse students about which type to implement (double vs int) and lead to mismatches in the constructor signature and getter return type expected by tests or by the exercise description.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the type of excellencyLevel consistent with the UML (double). Update the ExcellenceLand class in the template and solution to declare private double excellencyLevel, change the constructor parameter to double excellencyLevel, and change the getter to return double. Ensure any tests or example usages expect a double and update them if necessary.
